details.description: dall-e-2 is OpenAI's second-generation text-to-image model, historically offered at 256x256, 512x512 and 1024x1024 resolutions with support for image edits (inpainting with a transparency mask) and variations generated from an existing square image. OpenAI's own model page states plainly that DALL·E 2 has been deprecated and removed from its API and currently recommends GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst for image generation and editing; OpenAI's Deprecations page separately records a May 12, 2026 shutdown for DALL·E 2, naming gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1 or gpt-image-1-mini as replacements in that original notice. Microsoft's Azure OpenAI documentation separately lists dall-e-2 among its retired models, with a retirement date of January 27, 2025 and gpt-image-1 as the suggested replacement, meaning existing Azure deployments of it are no longer functional.
advantages: Supported image sizes of 256x256, 512x512 or 1024x1024, and was OpenAI's model for the image edits (inpainting) and variations endpoints, generating a new image from an existing square PNG (OpenAI DALL·E API guide).
disadvantages: Deprecated and removed from OpenAI's own API (shutdown May 12, 2026); OpenAI's model page recommends GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, though its Deprecations page originally named gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1 or gpt-image-1-mini (OpenAI dall-e-2 model page; OpenAI Deprecations page).
Retired on Azure OpenAI as of January 27, 2025, so existing Azure deployments are no longer functional; Microsoft's suggested replacement is gpt-image-1 (Microsoft Foundry retired models page).
use_cases: Generating images from a text prompt
Editing existing images via inpainting with a mask
Creating variations of an existing image

notes: GROUPING and STATUS: this target's only URI is azure/standard/1024-x-1024/dall-e-2, and both the maker (OpenAI) and the host (Azure) currently list dall-e-2 as fully retired/removed rather than merely deprecated -- OpenAI's own model page says it 'has been deprecated and removed from the API', and Azure's retired-models page gives a retirement date of 2025-01-27. This conflicts with the catalog's empty deprecation_date for this target; flagging so the catalog can be checked, since Bud may be routing to a model neither OpenAI nor Azure currently serves. OpenAI's Deprecations page shows dall-e-3 was shut down on the same 2026-05-12 date with the same replacement list, so DALL·E 3 is also no longer available and was removed as a claimed current successor.
